name: tool_worker
prompt: One production-ready static transparent PNG game asset for a medieval goblin side-scrolling mobile game. Same NON-PIXEL flat hand-painted cartoon art as the reference: irregular clean painted contours, broad matte muted ochre wood/gray iron/olive/brick-red patches, just two close-value shades per material, minimal volume. Strict side elevation, slight hand-drawn wonkiness, no top-down or isometric view. Large readable silhouette at 100 pixels high. Whole object framed with margin, all feet and support posts on one consistent ground baseline. No background, no cast shadow, no halo, no scenery, no characters, no text, letters, numbers, interface, glow or pixel blocks. Redesign the reference into a clearly distinct TALL goblin carpenter/tool workshop. Open-sided workshop, tall crossbeam with a very large hanging mallet-shaped wooden sign above a workbench. Timber bundles, saw and two mallets, muted ochre rag canopy on one side. Broad workbench with stout feet reaching ground. No weapons or coin piles.
review: accepted: oversized wooden mallet, saw timber and bench; carpenter distinct; non-pixel painted transparent static bitmap
